The one-year, fully paid professional immersion programme is designed to provide dynamic young citizens of ECOWAS Member States with practical experience within regional institutions, while contributing to the implementation of regional integration initiatives. Participants will also have the opportunity to develop valuable technical and professional skills under the guidance of experienced experts. Surprise-party themes are where the fun really kicks in   Here are some that always hit: Movie Night Premiere: Red carpet, popcorn bar, dress code is "their favorite movie character". Project clips of the guest of honor on the wall. 90s Throwback: Bucket hats, Tamagotchi, CD boombox, snacks like Dunkaroos. Playlist is all the bops from that decade. Glow in the Dark: Neon everything, blacklights, glow sticks, UV face paint. Works great for an evening surprise. Travel Without Leaving: Pick 3 countries they love. Different room = different country with food, music, decor. "Passport" as the invite. Murder Mystery Dinner: Guests get roles ahead of time. Everyone shows up in costume and you solve it over cake. Garden Picnic: Daytime, low tables, fairy lights, cozy blankets. Surprise them with their favorite foods and a acoustic playlist. Sports Fan Zone: Team jerseys, stadium snacks, big screen for highlights. Decor in team colors and a "jersey cake". Decade of You: Each table/decor piece represents a different decade of their life with photos and inside jokes. Quick tip: the best surprise themes have one easy dress code + one food/drink hook so people actually show up and play along. Which vibe fits the person you're surprising? Chill, loud, nostalgic, or fancy?
